texts.en:
Good. The £scientist£ Scientist has assumed command of our new £science_ship£ Science Ship, and can now be sent off at our leisure to explore new £system£ Systems and/or meet some grisly fate.

Should you wish to change the Scientist, then simply select the portrait once more in the fleet interface.
